caption: A car wash's foaming brushes turn from white to blue when the blue soap is sprayed on, and rinse back to white under clear water.

sa.check: A car wash's foaming brushes are white.
They rinse back to white under clear water.
The soap comes first, then the blue, then the rinse.

pc.expect: The colour spreads with the soap and washes out with the rinse water running downward.
pc.fail: The brushes turn blue before the soap arrives; or stay blue through the rinse; or turn white before the rinse.

pc.expect: The brushes are the soap's blue while soaped and white when rinsed.
pc.fail: They turn a different colour; or stay white under blue soap; or are blue with no soap.

pc.expect: The rinse water runs down the brushes.
pc.fail: It runs up; or hangs; or floats.

pc.expect: The brushes are soft strands that hold foam and drip.
pc.fail: They are rigid rods; or the foam is solid; or the strands melt.
A brush vanishes; or appears; or the soap becomes solid.

pc.expect: The car wash and the car stay the same.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or the bay changes; or the brushes change shape.
